purpose: Prove the crawler follows a journey into a SECOND browser page — target=_blank, window.open with a URL, and window.open to about:blank navigated a tick later — adopts it as the active page, re-attaches its observers, and fingerprints the ADOPTED page rather than the stale opener; and prove it records but never adopts a popup that is blank, foreign-origin or already closed.
targeted_defect: BUG-M15-POPUP-NEVER-ADOPTED — there was no context.on('page') anywhere in the crawler, so a second page was created and the crawler never learned it existed. Every subsequent action, inventory read, screenshot and fingerprint went to the page the journey had already left: a target=_blank step recorded the OPENER as if nothing had happened, and the tab the user is actually looking at was never inventoried. The Identical Copy control additionally reproduces the T-ND-04 half: a popup whose URL template, interactive controls and dialogs are all identical to its opener collapses to the same base digest and would silently inherit the opener's identity.

expect_controls.why: window.open to about:blank, navigated a tick later — judged at creation it reads as 'never navigated'
T-ND-04: the popup is identical to its opener in every DOM signal the fingerprint reads
a foreign origin — recorded, never adopted
opens and closes itself — adopting a dead handle breaks every later action
ordinary same-tab navigation must keep behaving ordinarily

describes_runtime_behaviour.behaviour: clicking Open Details adopts the new page: the port's active URL becomes details.html while the opener stays open
window.open to about:blank followed by a deferred navigation is adopted on the URL it settles on, not on about:blank
the adopted page is fingerprinted; a popup identical to its opener still receives a DISTINCT state identity
a foreign-origin popup and a self-closing popup are recorded as browser_events with disposition=retain and are never made active
when the active page closes, an open page is promoted and the promotion is recorded

lane_note: Capture assertions adjudicate in both lanes. The behavioural expectations are playwright-only: jsdom has no browser context, so it can neither create a second page nor report one. They are exercised by tests/browser/test_page_lifecycle_execution.py.
